hero.heading: Install Crustates in four steps.
hero.lead: Download the installer for your machine, write it to a USB stick, boot from it and finish setup in the browser. About [TIME] on most hardware.

notice.title: Crustates isn't released yet.
notice.body: The first release will be published on GitHub. The steps below show how installing will work.

amd64.body: Intel and AMD 64-bit machines: mini PCs, NAS boxes, servers.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Pick the ISO for your architecture and verify it (below).

steps.title: Write to USB
steps.body: Use any USB writer, or on Linux:

steps.title: Boot
steps.body: Turn on virtualization (VT-x or AMD-V) and the IOMMU in firmware, then boot from the stick. The installer checks your hardware first.

steps.title: Finish in the browser
steps.body: Open the address shown on screen. The first-run wizard sets up disks, networking and your admin passkey.

verify.heading: Check the checksum and the signature.
verify.lead: Every release is signed with cosign. Verify before you write it to USB.

requirements.heading: Hardware requirements
requirements.note: Raspberry Pi boards lack the interrupt controller microVMs need; apps there run with shared isolation.

channels.heading: Release channels

items.label: Stable
items.body: Tested releases for everyday use. The default.

items.label: Beta
items.body: Early access to the next release. Expect rough edges.

channels.upgradeBody: You don't need a new download. Go to Updates in the console or run crust molt upgrade. Upgrades are atomic and roll back in one step.
